fields.asset_name: Jinchuan Nickel & Cobalt - Jinchang cobalt (electrowon cobalt, Co3O4, cobalt salts)
fields.product: electrowon cobalt, cobalt tetroxide (Co3O4), cobalt salts

rows.notes: Xinhua Finance feature (2026-10-13), set in Jinchang (Gansu): 'electrowon cobalt 7,000 t, cobalt tetroxide 12,000 t, cobalt salts 10,000 t' capacity (nickel 190 kt electrolytic, 10 kt carbonyl). Capacity entered = 7,000 t Co electrowon cobalt only (the one line stated in contained-metal terms). Co3O4 12,000 t (x0.7342 = ~8,800 t Co if product tonnes) and cobalt salts 10,000 t (cobalt-metal vs product basis not stated) are NOT added to avoid mixing bases; together they would exceed the group's own 17,000 t 'cobalt products' (China Daily Jinchuan page, updated 2026-06-29, S2, which lists 7,000 t electrolytic cobalt as part of it) - an unresolved inconsistency between the two Jinchuan statements. capacity_ref_year 2026 = publication-year fallback. Coordinates = Jinchang city centroid (approximate, city-level), not a site location. Lanzhou Jinchuan Advanced Materials (Lanzhou, cobalt battery materials) is a separate Jinchuan site not sized here. 2022 trade press cited a 1.8 kt/yr expansion target (not opened).

fields.asset_name: GEM (Jiangsu) Cobalt - Taixing (cobalt tetroxide / cobalt materials)
fields.feedstock: recycled and primary cobalt intermediates (not stated in source)

rows.notes: China Daily-group article (2026-01-13): plant in Taixing Economic Development Zone 'now produces more than 10,000 metric tons per year of cobalt tetroxide'. This is a present-tense output rate, not a stated nameplate, so it is treated as a lower bound. Converted to contained cobalt with stoichiometric Co3O4 = 73.42% Co: 10,000 x 0.7342 = 7,342 t Co (conversion is mine; grade not stated in the source). capacity_ref_year 2026 = publication-year fallback. The article does not name the parent; GEM Co. identification rests on the GEM 2025 annual report (002340_2025.txt line 1561 lists a 'Taixing cobalt products research centre'; lines 3930-3932 mention a GEM executive's earlier post at Jiangsu Kelike Cobalt Co., which hints at the Kelike-to-GEM history but does not state it) and on the 'GEM (Jiangsu) Cobalt' name - the parent link and the 'formerly Kelike' naming are inferences. GEM company-wide 2025 (AR lines 561-563, 596): cobalt recovered >15,000 t; Co3O4 shipments 29,040 t; cobalt products (ultrafine powder, cobalt sheet, Co3O4) target 45,000 t in 2026 (line 3068). Site-level split of Co3O4 between Taixing, Wuxi and Jingmen is not disclosed. Coordinates = Taixing city centroid (approximate).

rows.notes: Only source is the SMM article of 2020-08-03 (the headline says phase II cobalt salt products 'have been put into production with an annual production capacity of 10000 metal tons'; a search summary noted the body text also mentions 'March 3', so the exact date is slightly inconsistent). 'Metal tons' read as t Co. The source is >6 years old: current operating status and capacity NOT re-confirmed (Gepai/Great Power nickel-cobalt later filed for a Hong Kong IPO; prospectus not opened). fields.feedstock: cobalt carbonate / intermediates from Ganzhou Hanrui and DRC
fields.operator: Anhui Hanrui New Materials Co., Ltd.

rows.notes: Hanrui 2025 AR (lines 432-433, 1719-1723): 100% subsidiary, registered capital RMB 68.88m, mainly produces/sells cobalt powder and cobalt salts; 2025 revenue RMB ~667.5m, net profit ~RMB 0.53m (as parsed from the split table row; columns not fully labelled). Capacity: Huaan Securities 2020-08-11 (page 1) says the 3,000 t metal-content cobalt powder line at Anhui Hanrui reached usable state in Aug 2019, lifting company cobalt-powder capacity from 1,500 t to 4,500 t (the 1,500 t is the Nanjing parent's own cobalt-powder line, not sized in the 2025 AR). The 3,000 t figure is 7 years old and not re-confirmed in the 2025 AR (no capacity table). Province Anhui from the subsidiary name; a search-result summary placed the registered address in Chuzhou (Suchu Modern Industrial Park) but that was not on an opened page, so coordinates are left null. Hanrui company cobalt products 2025 production = 16,761.79 t (see existing Ganzhou Hanrui row / company_totals).

fields.asset_name: Hongxing Development (Redstar) high-purity manganese sulphate (HPMSM) line
fields.parent_company: Guizhou Redstar Developing Co. (红星发展)

rows.notes: Splits out the HPMSM capacity that the existing row hongxing-development-dalong-manganese-emd-china (capacity unit t EMD) only mentions in notes; do NOT add the two capacities together as one asset's MnSO4 and EMD are different products, and the plant site of HPMSM is not stated in the AR (the existing row assumes Dalong Manganese, Guizhou; the AR text says only that the company has the line and that the subsidiary Dalong Manganese makes EMD) - lead may merge via part_of. Capacity 30,000 t/yr = AR 'existing 3万吨/年 HPMSM project' (2023 utilisation 56.13%, i.e. implied ~16.8 kt output in 2023, my arithmetic) = SMM 2025-07-11 quoting the company; EnergyTrend 2022 also says current capacity 30,000 t/yr. Normalised by build: 30,000 t MnSO4 x 0.325 = 9,750 t Mn. 2025 HPMSM output not disclosed in the AR. Province left null.

fields.asset_name: Guizhou Nengkuang (Guizhou Manganese Mineral Group) Dalong - HPMSM and EMD
fields.product: high-purity manganese sulphate (HPMSM) and electrolytic manganese dioxide (EMD)
fields.operator: Guizhou Nengkuang Manganese Industry Group (Guizhou Manganese Mineral Group Co.)

rows.notes: Located in the Dalong Economic and Technological Development Zone, Tongren (Guizhou provincial portal, S13). Capacity 30,000 t/yr HPMSM = phase 1 (broke ground Aug 2017) per Asian Metal Dec 2022 (search-summary only, tier reported). Phase 2 (RMB 490m, +30,000 t HPMSM and +16,500 t EMD, 'construction to start in 2023') has no completion date and no later confirmation, so it is excluded (undated, D-015); the full plan would be 60,000 t HPMSM / 33,000 t EMD. SMM 2024-12-27 says the company 'currently' has 16,500 mt EMD capacity, i.e. only phase 1 EMD existed then (supports operational status for phase 1, and suggests phase 2 was not built by end-2024). CONFLICT: the Guizhou government page gives phase-1 HPMSM as '300,000 metric tons' and total '6 tons' - evident machine-translation errors for 30,000/60,000 t; the 30,000 value is the one used. EMD 16,500 t is not entered (no t EMD capacity field; one capacity per row). Exact town/coordinates not stated. capacity_ref_year 2022 = publication fallback.

fields.asset_name: Firebird Metals Jinshi (Hunan) HPMSM plant - stage 1
fields.product: high-purity manganese sulphate monohydrate (HPMSM) and manganese tetroxide (Mn3O4)
fields.feedstock: third-party manganese ore (about 66,000 t for stage 1)
fields.offtakers: multiple offtake MOUs covering about 70% of potential MnSO4 production (ASX offtake announcement, search summary)

rows.notes: All evidence is search-result summaries (tier reported): the Mining.com / Mining Weekly / Engineering News / ASX pages returned HTTP 403 or unreadable PDFs. Stage 1: 50,000 tpa MnSO4 + 10,000 tpa Mn3O4 (also quoted as '72,500 tpa MnSO4-equivalent' in the feasibility study; earlier scoping 72,000-75,000 t - sources differ), at Jinshi, Hunan; permits reported as obtained and first production once targeted for late 2025, but no FID or construction announcement was found in 2026 (a 2026 ASX filing lists a board FID as a remaining condition; 2026 news covers the Hunan pilot plant, 99.99% product, and a Perth demonstration plant). Hence status announced (not under construction); capacity_ref_year 2025 = the stated first-production target year, which has passed unmet. Planned expansion to 300 kt MnSO4 (China) + 100 kt (West) not recorded (undated aspiration). Publication date of the Mining.com item is approximate (2025). Coordinates not given (Jinshi named only).
